description: S5. Thassa's Oracle and Demonic Consultation in tymna_thrasios's hand on its turn (pod n7WpsqsZtdQ), with UU and B open. The line: Consultation naming a card not in the library exiles the library, then Oracle's enter trigger wins (or Oracle first, Consultation in response to the trigger). Tests the one line the plan pilot converts in games (17 same-turn Oracle wins on plan seats, 0 for stock, which refuses Consultation: it carries AI:RemoveDeck:All). Success: tymna_thrasios wins on the scenario turn.
notes: Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction; every seat at 40 life.
A pilot that casts Consultation without then winning exiles its own library and loses on its next draw; the report's winner and alive fields show it.
